exotics.name: Divinity

exotics.name: Izanagi's Burden

exotics.name: Merciless

exotics.name: One Thousand Voices

exotics.name: Parasite

exotics.name: Praxic Blade

exotics.name: Alethonym
exotics.summary: stackable micro-missile GL that gets ammo creation charges via pickups

exotics.name: Anarchy

exotics.name: Bastion

exotics.name: Euphony

exotics.name: Tessellation

exotics.name: Arbalest

exotics.name: Buried Bloodline

exotics.name: Dragon's Breath

exotics.name: Graviton Lance
exotics.summary: chaining void explosion and seeker orbs on kill, has Turnabout
